task: Remove the upward core-to-handlers dependency by moving init-check hash and gate primitives into a core module.
outcome: User can see that core/machine.ts no longer imports handlers/init-check, while INIT_CHECK hash, required-reviewer, and blocking-issue gates still behave the same under validation.
facts: core/machine.ts currently imports recomputeInitCheckHash, missingRequiredInitCheckAgents, and blockingInitCheckIssues from ../handlers/init-check.js.
handlers/init-check.ts owns pure hash and gate helpers plus the init_check_set command handler shell.
delivery-check already has the precedent packages/main/src/core/delivery-check-hash.ts consumed by core code and handler code.
Search shows only core/machine.ts has the upward init-check handler import; registry owner strings can remain command ownership for init_check_set.
Targeted verification should include npm run build, npm run test:init-check-bootstrap, npm run test:worktree-authority-smoke, and a grep proving core imports no handlers/init-check module.
constraints: Do not change INIT_CHECK phase semantics.
Do not change reviewer flow or required reviewers.
Keep a single implementation of the hash/gate primitives.
Use Koala CLI for story metadata and preserve the worktree lifecycle.
